source: Copy of a real quick-testing run (orch-20261031T151451Z-quick-testing-2026-11-01T0949308016730000): its own plan, interface and approvals. Built by '/code demo basic' from demo_scripts/uart_top.json with no model call; NOT an autonomous model-generated testbench.

configuration.note: The run's interface was re-extracted with this define because the built-in bus driver needs the 8-bit configuration; the 32-bit configuration is not supported by it.

demonstrates: named register writes through cg_reg_access::write (divisor, framing, FIFO control)
one byte transmitted through the bus and checked on the serial output
one byte driven on the serial input and read back from the bus
